primary_question: For independently sealed software-engineering tasks, does a real tool-using agent with FAR's strict semantic-and-evidence checker resolve more tasks than the same agent using an active generic semantic collision checker?

arms.exposure: same tool-call interface and permitted access as FAR

arms.role: actual strict FAR semantic and evidence-integrity checker
arms.exposure: same tool-call interface and permitted access as generic

design.target: independently verified task-resolution probability among the prospectively sealed eligible task set
design.task_identity_rule: Use independently produced sealed task bundle and one-to-one blinded identity ledger, same exact source snapshot across arms; exclude Project FAR/forks/treatment exposure, all prior SWE-agent tasks and sacrificial pilot tasks
design.selection_rule: Independent custodian screens prospective external repository tasks with frozen inclusion/exclusion decisions before agent access; no outcome-dependent substitution
design.order_rule: Frozen independent random seed, balanced counterbalanced per-task arm and repetition ordering; no shared histories or PR merges into shared upstream; independent resettable snapshots
run_equivalence: same system/agent prompts except frozen checker treatment
same tool names, invocation affordances, permissions and budgets
same container image, dependencies, repository commit and task specification
no cross-arm hints, memory or task outcome exposure
same independent hidden scorer and outcome contract

primary_endpoint.source: sealed external grader on final isolated workspace state
primary_endpoint.infrastructure_invalid: retain original; at most one independently authorized same-slot replacement before any outcome reveal; if still invalid, retain missing cell and classify study inconclusive
primary_endpoint.denominator: all frozen task-arm-repetition slots; every frozen task contributes paired arm means unless any required cell is missing

statistics.estimand: mean over frozen tasks of (mean resolved repetitions under FAR minus mean resolved repetitions under generic checker)
statistics.uncertainty: paired task-cluster bootstrap, 100000 resamples, equal-tailed 95% percentile interval; exact SHA-256 rejection-stream RNG and type-7 quantile from governed SWE-agent v3 protocol; seed separately frozen before unblinding
statistics.positive_rule: all complete; FAR-minus-generic estimate >= 1/10; lower 95% bound > 0; no critical harm; mechanism instrumentation integrity verified
statistics.harm_rule: no missing cells and upper 95% bound < 0, or preregistered critical harm threshold triggered (report separately)
statistics.no_advantage_rule: no missing cells and upper 95% bound < 1/10; do not infer equivalence
secondary: FAR vs generic activation and behavioral effect

mechanism_receipts.capture_boundary: independent trusted harness observing actual invoked tool process and pre/post agent/environment state
mechanism_receipts.provenance: content-address all raw evidence; independent runtime witness signing and signed artifact-store admission required before any result is described as authenticated

before_pilot: protocol promoted through protected main with independent exact-head review
independent custodian holds sealed task manifest and audited identity ledger
frozen treatment/checker source, model, agent, environments, budgets and randomization
independent prospective launch record with explicit manual authorization
before_confirmatory: successful separately authorized excluded sacrificial pilot
all pilot requirements still valid for exact confirmatory heads
signed task-seal and identity-audit record held separately from capsule authors and operators
complete independent confirmatory launch authorization before any model/task call
after_execution: independent scorer verifies original final state
independent auditor reconstructs receipts from observer-owned event logs and authenticates signatures
analysis independently reproduced from frozen task order and sealed run denominator
forbidden: unblinding before task and treatment freeze
self-sealing or signing as independent custodian
marking a gate true from authored placeholders
running a model/benchmark under SWE-agent v3's currently false gates
fabricating external authorization, execution or outcomes

nonclaims: no general agent reliability claim without completed prospective trial
no inference of mechanism causal mediation from observational receipts
no reuse or promotion of frozen SWE-agent v3 data
no theoretical proof or commercial superiority
a research PR is not a preregistration freeze until reviewed protected-main promotion
